story.body:
My story
I come to you as someone who has walked a unique professional path, from leading companies and managing projects in Portugal to embracing web development, Agile project management, and content creation in Germany. This journey has not been simple, but it has shaped me into someone who values curiosity, communication, and meaningful work.

Before entering the tech world, I managed a family business with deep organizational challenges: four owners in conflict, outdated processes, and a complete lack of internal communication.
I started there at sixteen, as a retail assistant. Years later, as the manager, I helped rebuild trust, reorganize teams, and open space for honest dialogue. It was there that I learned my first real lesson in leadership: progress begins when people feel safe to speak and are given room to grow.

That experience stayed with me when I moved into technology.
Today, I apply the same principles of empathy, clarity, and structure to every project I lead or build. Whether it’s writing a clean React component, managing an Agile sprint, or mentoring a junior developer, my goal is always the same: create environments where people and ideas can thrive together.

I am a Google certified Project Manager and Frontend Developer specialized in React, TypeScript, SCSS, and Node.js.
Here, through The Human Tech Blog, I write about frontend development, agile practices, digital transformation, and the human side of technology. My articles are a mix of tutorials, reflections, and honest stories about learning, failure, and growth in the tech world.

I believe technology is not just about building products, it’s about building understanding. When communication improves, code improves, and so do teams.

Core Highlights
• Over 20 years of leadership experience in business and technology
• Frontend and full stack development with React, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB
• Strong foundation in Agile and Scrum methodologies
• 50+ published articles on technology, leadership, and digital transformation in the blog
• Experience in GDPR compliance, workflow automation, and process optimization
• Fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish | Intermediate German, Italian, and French

If you share an interest in technology, leadership, or the craft of building better teams, I invite you to explore my articles, and if something resonates, let’s connect.
